_comment: Claude Code subagent metadata. Source for the frontmatter of .claude/agents/*.md (generated by scripts/agent-validation/sync-claude-agents.js). `tools` is omitted for agents that need MCP servers (Playwright, Stitch) so they inherit them; contracts + hooks still bound their writes. The Agent tool is added automatically when the contract's may_spawn is non-empty.

orchestrator.description: Master orchestrator for website projects. Use to run the NEW_WEBSITE, REDESIGN or ENHANCE lifecycle: routes work to specialists, enforces quality gates G1-G13 and refuses premature release.

requirement-grilling.description: Requirements interrogator. Use before any design or code when a website brief is vague: asks one high-leverage question at a time and produces REQUIREMENTS.md with REQ-IDs.

product-discovery.description: Product discovery specialist. Use to turn approved requirements into personas, user journeys and an information-architecture sitemap (USER_JOURNEYS.md).

design-art-director.description: Art director enforcing anti-slop visual direction (Taste Skill). Use to set or review the aesthetic thesis, palette, typography and to reject generic template looks and unmotivated gradients.

ux-ui-designer.description: UX/UI critic using the Impeccable 24-command heuristics. Use to critique layouts, hierarchy, typesetting and usability and to produce a P0-P3 prioritised UI_CRITIQUE_REPORT.md.

stitch-design-engineer.description: Google Stitch design engineer. Use to generate or sync screens via the Stitch MCP, map them to design tokens, and record them in STITCH_DESIGN_SPEC.md.

frontend-architect.description: Frontend architect. Use to choose the stack, define component hierarchy, state model, routing and design-token wiring before implementation starts (ARCHITECTURE.md).

implementation-engineer.description: Implementation engineer. Use to write semantic, responsive, accessible frontend code in src/ against an approved design and failing tests. Cannot edit tests or review verdicts.

tdd-test-engineer.description: TDD specialist. Use to drive Red-Green-Refactor on a vertical slice: writes the failing test first, records the RED receipt, and verifies GREEN before certification (G7).

motion-engineer.description: Motion and interaction engineer (Emil Kowalski standard). Use to add micro-interactions and transitions under 300ms with natural easing and full prefers-reduced-motion support.

browser-qa.description: Playwright browser QA engineer. Use to verify a site in a real browser across the 6 mandatory viewports (overflow, touch targets, vitals, axe) and to write BROWSER_QA_REPORT.md. Never claims a pass it did not run.

security-auditor.description: Security auditor (OWASP Top 10 + STRIDE). Use for a threat model and vulnerability review of a site; produces SECURITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md. Any Critical/High finding blocks release.

web-performance-auditor.description: Web performance auditor. Use to review Core Web Vitals, asset weight and render-blocking resources; separates lab-measured numbers from static observations and never invents metrics.

seo-accessibility.description: SEO and accessibility specialist. Use to verify WCAG 2.2 AA (contrast, keyboard, semantics) plus metadata, Open Graph and JSON-LD; produces SEO_REPORT.md and ACCESSIBILITY_REPORT.md.

code-reviewer.description: Independent code and architecture reviewer. Use after implementation for a two-axis review (standards and spec). Read-only on source: writes only its review report and defect register.

production-reviewer.description: Production readiness reviewer. Use last: independently consolidates gates G1-G13 and signs off or blocks release in RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md. Cannot edit source or tests.
